title: Dead of Night
overview: The Prologue introduces Kliff, a leader of the Greymanes, as his group is ambushed by the Black Bears. After being defeated and thrown into a river, he survives through a mysterious experience in the Abyss and begins a new journey.

factions.name: Greymanes
factions.description: Warriors who protect Pailune, composed of skilled individuals from diverse backgrounds.

factions.name: Black Bears
factions.description: A brutal rival faction led by Myurdin, driven by power and destruction.

quests.name: Unfamiliar Lands
quests.outcome: Black Bears attack, initiating combat tutorial.

quests.name: In Ashes
quests.outcome: Kliff is defeated and thrown into the river.

quests.name: Realm of Uncertainty
quests.outcome: Kliff survives and gains mysterious power.

locations.name: Hills of No Return
locations.description: Starting forest region near the Greymanes camp.

locations.name: Nas River
locations.description: River where Kliff is thrown and survives.

locations.name: Corridor of the Void
locations.description: Mysterious realm between life and death.

locations.name: Tree Saints’ Falls
locations.description: Location where Kliff recovers after the Abyss.

locations.name: Freesword Encampment
locations.description: Safe zone marking the end of the Prologue.

title: The First Encounter - Hernand Town
overview: Chapter 1 begins after Kliff reaches Hernand Town at the end of the Prologue. Pywel begins opening up, but the best route is to stay focused on the main story until Kliff gains more core abilities.
recommended_path: Do not fully explore Hernand Town yet. Follow the Chapter 1 main quest chain first. Save deeper exploration for Chapter 2.

quests.name: Where Rumors Gather
objectives: Use the bed and storage if needed
quests.outcome: Kliff begins Chapter 1 and learns important town systems.

quests.name: Mysterious Man
objectives: Find the sleeping beggar near the sewer entrance
quests.outcome: The beggar vanishes mysteriously, revealing the event as part of a supernatural trial.

quests.name: True Wisdom in Kindness
quests.outcome: Another mystical kindness trial is completed.

quests.name: Heart Beyond Borders
quests.outcome: Kliff helps Rulupee and earns another quest item.

quests.name: Actions Speak Louder Than Words
quests.outcome: Kliff receives clothing needed to enter Hernand Castle.

quests.name: Mystical Key
objectives: Reach the locked chamber on the second floor
quests.outcome: Kliff discovers the first Abyss Gate and travels to the Axiom Archive.

locations.name: Freesword Encampment
locations.description: Starting area for Chapter 1 near Hernand Castle. Contains a bed, storage, bonfire, animals, and NPCs.

locations.name: Abyss Nexus
locations.description: Fast travel point that should be activated when entering a new area.

locations.name: Bell Tower
locations.description: Tower used to reveal surrounding map information and nearby points of interest.

locations.name: Hernand Tavern
locations.description: Main quest destination where Kliff speaks with Dahlia and can play Arm Wrestling.

locations.name: Hernand Sewers
locations.description: Small hidden area containing early gear, items, and a kindness trial.

locations.name: Muckroot Ranch
locations.description: Location of the smoking house where Kliff helps Arlan and Lauren.

locations.name: Hernand Castle
locations.description: Castle that Kliff can enter after equipping Hernandian Attire.

locations.name: Alchemist’s Chamber
locations.description: Locked room opened with the Mystical Key. Contains Abyss rewards and an Abyss Gate.

locations.name: Axiom Archive
locations.description: Abyss destination reached from the gate in the Alchemist’s Chamber.

systems_introduced.name: Abyss Nexus
systems_introduced.description: Fast travel point. Activate it by standing on it, then use it from the map later.

systems_introduced.name: Bells
systems_introduced.description: Map-revealing towers. Ringing a bell clears nearby fog of war and reveals points of interest.

systems_introduced.name: Faction Quests
systems_introduced.description: Optional reputation-based missions tied to groups across Pywel.

systems_introduced.name: Notice Boards
systems_introduced.description: Boards that offer bounties, commissions, vendor leads, and clue-based tasks.

systems_introduced.name: Abyss Gate
systems_introduced.description: One-way portal from Pywel into the Abyss.

systems_introduced.name: Abyss Artifact
systems_introduced.description: Used to gain Skill Points or improve stats such as Health, Stamina, and Spirit.

systems_introduced.name: Faded Abyss Artifact
systems_introduced.description: Respec item that lets Kliff reset the skill tree.

systems_introduced.name: Hidden Spaces
systems_introduced.description: Secret areas containing trials, gear, puzzles, or lore.

systems_introduced.name: Memory Fragments
systems_introduced.description: Past visions triggered with the Visione helmet.

systems_introduced.name: Learn Skill
systems_introduced.description: Some abilities are learned by observing Echoes, NPCs, or enemies.

systems_introduced.name: Mounts
systems_introduced.description: Permanent rideable creatures and machines such as horses, dragons, wyverns, raptors, and mechs.

systems_introduced.name: Minigames
systems_introduced.description: Optional activities including tavern games and combat challenges.

minigames.name: Arm Wrestling
steps: Press the timing key when the needle reaches the highlighted area
minigames.outcome: Winning gives Kliff early money and introduces tavern minigames.

summary: Chapter 1 starts in Hernand Town after the Prologue. It introduces fast travel, map bells, reputation, minigames, hidden spaces, disguises, and Abyss mechanics. The Trials of Kindness questline tests Kliff through helpful actions and eventually leads him into Hernand Castle, the Alchemist’s Chamber, and the first Abyss Gate.
